summary: The trace shows the agent correctly built complex Excel formulas using openpyxl but FAILED verification. The formulas appear structurally correct per the existing skill's guidance (proper $ locking, PERCENTILE.INC, etc.), yet the test suite failed. This signals a gap between formula construction and actual Excel evaluation - likely the formulas were never executed by Excel itself, leaving them as unevaluated strings that test assertions cannot read as values. The skill needs: (1) explicit guidance that openpyxl formulas require Excel or a calculation engine to evaluate, (2) error handling for common INDEX/MATCH failures (wrong match mode, type mismatches), (3) validation the Data sheet actually contains the expected data before building formulas, and (4) escalation when pure openpyxl hits its limits. The existing skill over-focuses on formula string construction without addressing the critical gap: formulas that look correct may still fail silently at evaluation time.
